title: JUNK
text: JUNK. This is one of the worst things I have ever bought. It took over a month to get there and when it did it was all bent up because they put it in a plastic shipping bag instead of a box. Also the magnets that are supposed to keep it attached to the top of your microwave do not work. I would not recommend this to anyone.

product_metadata.title: Hover Cover Magnetic Microwave Splatter Lid with Steam Vents Cover | Dishwasher Safe BPA Free | 11 Inch
features: FITS MOST – Hover Cover is 11 inches large enough to fit most dinner plates, dishes, bowls and even platters. Hover Cover fits in most microwave ovens, including smaller models. It’s perfect for mess free after school snacks! Reheating left overs without the spill overs and easy meals on the go

MICROWAVE SAFE & PROTECTS - Against food splatter! Stop cooking without a cover! Get Hover Cover! The revolutionary splatter guard that uses 4 microwave safe polymer encased magnets to attach to the top of your microwave so it’s always ready to use! The cover protects your microwave from foods that are messy when heating up

EASY TO USE: Hover Cover’s built in steam vents let the steam out and keeps the splatter in! The special BPA material stays cool to the touch and the nonstick surface easily wipes or rinses clean. Hover Cover is top rack dishwasher safe. Just pull down to cover and when you’re done, lift and let it hover! Attaches to roof of microwave when not in use

CLEVER DESIGN: The 4 polymer-encased magnets will help keep your cover out of the way when not in use. The Polypropylene microwaveable splatter cover will save you hours of cleaning each week as this high-quality protects the walls of your microwave oven from food splatter while you heat your favorite meal or snack
